description: This file defines the ReviewKpiSearchFilterParams class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used to encapsulate filtering parameters for review KPI searches within the Performance module of OrangeHRM. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties for review ID and reviewer group name, with corresponding getter and setter methods. It also defines allowed sort fields.

classes.name: ReviewKpiSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class to specify filter parameters for searching Review KPIs, including review ID and reviewer group name. It extends from FilterParams and sets default sorting by KPI title.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object and sets the default sort field to 'kpi.title'.

methods.name: getReviewId
methods.description: Returns the review ID used as a filter.

methods.name: setReviewId
methods.description: Sets the review ID for filtering purposes.

methods.name: getReviewerGroupName
methods.description: Returns the reviewer group name used as a filter.

methods.name: setReviewerGroupName
methods.description: Sets the reviewer group name for filtering purposes.
